findings.location: Article, III.b Preaching, quotation of Mark 1:14
findings.source_quote: …[He] came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God –Mark 1:14.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the quotation with: …[Alifika] Galilaya, akihubiri Injili ya ufalme wa Mungu –Marko 1:14.

findings.location: Article, III.b Preaching, quotation of Romans 10:17
findings.source_quote: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God –Romans 10:17.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the quotation with: Basi imani huja kwa kusikia, na kusikia huja kwa neno la Mungu –Warumi 10:17.
findings.translation_quote: Basi imani, chanzo chake ni kusikia; na kusikia huja kwa neno la Kristo –Warumi 10:17.

findings.location: Article, III.c Singing, quotation of Ephesians 5:19
findings.source_quote: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord –Ephesians 5:19.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the quotation with: Mkisemezana kwa zaburi na nyimbo na tenzi za rohoni, mkiimba na kufanya melody mioyoni mwenu kwa Bwana –Waefeso 5:19. Translate “making melody” idiomatically into Kiswahili while preserving that it means making melody in the heart; for example: Mkisemezana kwa zaburi, nyimbo na tenzi za rohoni, mkiimba na kuimba kwa moyo wenu kwa Bwana –Waefeso 5:19.
findings.translation_quote: Mkisemezana kwa zaburi na tenzi na nyimbo za rohoni, huku mkiimba na kumshangilia Bwana mioyoni mwenu –Waefeso 5:19.

findings.location: Article, IV Essence of True Worship, final paragraph
findings.source_quote: If our spirits are not responding to truth, we are not worshiping!
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the missing space and render “worshiping” as a single word: Ikiwa roho zetu haziitikii kweli, hatuabudu!
findings.translation_quote: Ikiwa roho zetu haziitikii kweli, hatu abudu!

findings.location: Article, Works Cited, title of A. W. Tozer work
findings.source_quote: The Menace of the Religious Movie, A. W. Tozer, Wisconsin Rapids: Rapids Christian Press.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the title faithfully as “Tishio la Filamu za Kidini” (or another idiomatic rendering conveying the plural/general “religious movie”).
findings.translation_quote: Tishio la Filamu ya Kidini, A. W. Tozer, Wisconsin Rapids: Rapids Christian Press.
